options.content:
## Kiro + DORA Dashboard
This dashboard compares **Kiro usage** with **DORA** performance indicators at monthly aggregates.

- **Kiro metrics**: active users, credits, messages, conversations, and credits per message
- **DORA metrics**: lead time, deployment frequency, and change failure rate
- **Semantic boundary**: Kiro does not export accepted LOC, suggestion acceptance, generated tests, or code-review findings; no proxy is presented as an equivalent measure

panels.description: Unique Kiro users in the selected period, from the daily usage report.

targets.rawSql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT user_id) AS 'Active Kiro Users' FROM _tool_kiro_user_report WHERE $__timeFilter(date)

panels.title: Kiro Active Users

panels.description: Kiro exports credits, not accepted lines of code. Accepted LOC has no equivalent field.

targets.rawSql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(credits_used), 1) AS 'Kiro Credits Used' FROM _tool_kiro_user_report WHERE $__timeFilter(date)

panels.title: Total Kiro Credits

panels.description: Kiro does not export suggestion acceptance. Credits per message is a usage-efficiency ratio, not an acceptance rate.

targets.rawSql: SELECT SUM(credits_used) / NULLIF(SUM(total_messages), 0) AS 'Credits per Message' FROM _tool_kiro_user_report WHERE $__timeFilter(date)

panels.title: Credits per Message

panels.description: Number of production deployments in selected period

targets.rawSql:
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT cdc.cicd_deployment_id) as 'Deployments'
FROM cicd_deployment_commits cdc
JOIN project_mapping pm ON cdc.cicd_scope_id = pm.row_id AND pm.`table` = 'cicd_scopes'
WHERE pm.project_name IN (${project})
  AND cdc.result = 'SUCCESS'
  AND cdc.environment = 'PRODUCTION'
  AND $__timeFilter(cdc.finished_date)

panels.title: Total Deployments

panels.description: Median lead time for changes in hours

targets.rawSql:
WITH _pr_stats AS (
  SELECT
    distinct pr.id,
    ppm.pr_cycle_time
  FROM pull_requests pr
  JOIN project_pr_metrics ppm ON ppm.id = pr.id
  JOIN project_mapping pm ON pr.base_repo_id = pm.row_id AND pm.`table` = 'repos'
  JOIN cicd_deployment_commits cdc ON ppm.deployment_commit_id = cdc.id
  WHERE pm.project_name IN (${project})
    AND pr.merged_date IS NOT NULL
    AND ppm.pr_cycle_time IS NOT NULL
    AND $__timeFilter(cdc.finished_date)
),
_median_ranks AS (
  SELECT *, percent_rank() OVER(ORDER BY pr_cycle_time) AS ranks
  FROM _pr_stats
)
SELECT ROUND(MAX(pr_cycle_time) / 60, 1) AS 'Lead Time (hours)'
FROM _median_ranks
WHERE ranks <= 0.5

panels.title: Median Lead Time

panels.description: Percentage of deployments that caused incidents

targets.rawSql:
WITH _deployments AS (
  SELECT
    cdc.cicd_deployment_id AS deployment_id,
    MAX(cdc.finished_date) AS deployment_finished_date
  FROM cicd_deployment_commits cdc
  JOIN project_mapping pm ON cdc.cicd_scope_id = pm.row_id AND pm.`table` = 'cicd_scopes'
  WHERE pm.project_name IN (${project})
    AND cdc.result = 'SUCCESS'
    AND cdc.environment = 'PRODUCTION'
  GROUP BY 1
  HAVING $__timeFilter(MAX(cdc.finished_date))
),
_failure_caused AS (
  SELECT
    d.deployment_id,
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN i.id IS NOT NULL THEN d.deployment_id ELSE NULL END) AS has_incident
  FROM _deployments d
  LEFT JOIN project_incident_deployment_relationships pim ON d.deployment_id = pim.deployment_id
  LEFT JOIN incidents i ON pim.id = i.id
  GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT 
  CASE WHEN COUNT(deployment_id) = 0 THEN NULL 
       ELSE SUM(has_incident) / COUNT(deployment_id) 
  END AS 'Change Failure Rate'
FROM _failure_caused

panels.title: Change Failure Rate

panels.description: Kiro credits are compared with Lead Time. Kiro does not export accepted code lines.

targets.rawSql:
WITH ai_monthly AS (
  SELECT 
    DATE_FORMAT(date, '%Y-%m-01') AS month,
    SUM(credits_used) AS kiro_credits
  FROM _tool_kiro_user_report
  WHERE $__timeFilter(date)
  GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(date, '%Y-%m-01')
),
lead_time_monthly AS (
  SELECT
    DATE_FORMAT(cdc.finished_date, '%Y-%m-01') AS month,
    AVG(ppm.pr_cycle_time) / 60 AS avg_lead_time
  FROM pull_requests pr
  JOIN project_pr_metrics ppm ON ppm.id = pr.id
  JOIN project_mapping pm ON pr.base_repo_id = pm.row_id AND pm.`table` = 'repos'
  JOIN cicd_deployment_commits cdc ON ppm.deployment_commit_id = cdc.id
  WHERE pm.project_name IN (${project})
    AND pr.merged_date IS NOT NULL
    AND ppm.pr_cycle_time IS NOT NULL
    AND $__timeFilter(cdc.finished_date)
  GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(cdc.finished_date, '%Y-%m-01')
)
SELECT 
  STR_TO_DATE(COALESCE(ai.month, lt.month), '%Y-%m-%d') AS time,
  ai.kiro_credits AS 'Kiro Credits',
  ROUND(lt.avg_lead_time, 1) AS 'Median Lead Time (hours)'
FROM ai_monthly ai
LEFT JOIN lead_time_monthly lt ON ai.month = lt.month
WHERE ai.month IS NOT NULL OR lt.month IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY time

panels.title: Kiro Credits vs Lead Time Trend

panels.description: Usage-efficiency ratio versus deployment frequency. This is not suggestion acceptance.

targets.rawSql:
WITH ai_acceptance AS (
  SELECT 
    DATE_FORMAT(date, '%Y-%m-01') AS month,
    SUM(credits_used) / NULLIF(SUM(total_messages), 0) AS credits_per_message
  FROM _tool_kiro_user_report
  WHERE $__timeFilter(date)
  GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(date, '%Y-%m-01')
),
deployment_count AS (
  SELECT 
    DATE_FORMAT(MAX(cdc.finished_date), '%Y-%m-01') AS month,
    COUNT(DISTINCT cdc.cicd_deployment_id) AS deploy_count
  FROM cicd_deployment_commits cdc
  JOIN project_mapping pm ON cdc.cicd_scope_id = pm.row_id AND pm.`table` = 'cicd_scopes'
  WHERE pm.project_name IN (${project})
    AND cdc.result = 'SUCCESS'
    AND cdc.environment = 'PRODUCTION'
    AND $__timeFilter(cdc.finished_date)
  GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(cdc.finished_date, '%Y-%m-01')
)
SELECT 
  STR_TO_DATE(COALESCE(ai.month, dc.month), '%Y-%m-%d') AS time,
  ai.credits_per_message AS 'Credits per Message',
  dc.deploy_count AS 'Deployment Count'
FROM ai_acceptance ai
LEFT JOIN deployment_count dc ON ai.month = dc.month
WHERE ai.month IS NOT NULL OR dc.month IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY time

panels.title: Credits per Message vs Deployment Frequency

panels.description: Kiro does not export generated-test counts; total messages is the available activity-volume measure.

targets.rawSql:
WITH ai_tests AS (
  SELECT 
    DATE_FORMAT(date, '%Y-%m-01') AS month,
    SUM(total_messages) AS kiro_messages
  FROM _tool_kiro_user_report
  WHERE $__timeFilter(date)
  GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(date, '%Y-%m-01')
),
cfr_monthly AS (
  SELECT
    DATE_FORMAT(deployment_finished_date, '%Y-%m-01') AS month,
    SUM(has_incident) / NULLIF(COUNT(deployment_id), 0) AS cfr
  FROM (
    SELECT
      d.deployment_id,
      d.deployment_finished_date,
      COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN i.id IS NOT NULL THEN d.deployment_id ELSE NULL END) AS has_incident
    FROM (
      SELECT
        cdc.cicd_deployment_id AS deployment_id,
        MAX(cdc.finished_date) AS deployment_finished_date
      FROM cicd_deployment_commits cdc
      JOIN project_mapping pm ON cdc.cicd_scope_id = pm.row_id AND pm.`table` = 'cicd_scopes'
      WHERE pm.project_name IN (${project})
        AND cdc.result = 'SUCCESS'
        AND cdc.environment = 'PRODUCTION'
      GROUP BY 1
      HAVING $__timeFilter(MAX(cdc.finished_date))
    ) d
    LEFT JOIN project_incident_deployment_relationships pim ON d.deployment_id = pim.deployment_id
    LEFT JOIN incidents i ON pim.id = i.id
    GROUP BY 1, 2
  ) failure_data
  GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(deployment_finished_date, '%Y-%m-01')
)
SELECT 
  STR_TO_DATE(COALESCE(ai.month, cfr.month), '%Y-%m-%d') AS time,
  ai.kiro_messages AS 'Kiro Messages',
  cfr.cfr AS 'Change Failure Rate'
FROM ai_tests ai
LEFT JOIN cfr_monthly cfr ON ai.month = cfr.month
WHERE ai.month IS NOT NULL OR cfr.month IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY time

panels.title: Kiro Messages vs Change Failure Rate

panels.description: Kiro does not export code-review findings. Shows active users and credits by month.

targets.rawSql: SELECT STR_TO_DATE(month_start, '%Y-%m-%d') AS time, active_users AS 'Active Users', kiro_credits AS 'Kiro Credits' FROM (SELECT DATE_FORMAT(date, '%Y-%m-01') AS month_start, COUNT(DISTINCT user_id) AS active_users, SUM(credits_used) AS kiro_credits FROM _tool_kiro_user_report WHERE $__timeFilter(date) GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(date, '%Y-%m-01')) monthly ORDER BY time

panels.title: Kiro Users vs Credits

panels.description: Monthly Kiro usage metrics beside DORA metrics. LOC, acceptance, generated tests, and review findings are not exported by Kiro.

targets.rawSql:
WITH ai_metrics AS (
  SELECT 
    DATE_FORMAT(date, '%Y-%m') AS month,
    COUNT(DISTINCT user_id) AS active_users,
    SUM(credits_used) AS credits,
    SUM(credits_used) / NULLIF(SUM(total_messages), 0) AS credits_per_message,
    SUM(total_messages) AS messages,
    SUM(chat_conversations) AS conversations
  FROM _tool_kiro_user_report
  WHERE $__timeFilter(date)
  GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(date, '%Y-%m')
),
dora_metrics AS (
  SELECT
    DATE_FORMAT(cdc.finished_date, '%Y-%m') AS month,
    COUNT(DISTINCT cdc.cicd_deployment_id) AS deployments,
    AVG(ppm.pr_cycle_time) / 60 AS avg_lead_time
  FROM cicd_deployment_commits cdc
  JOIN project_mapping pm ON cdc.cicd_scope_id = pm.row_id AND pm.`table` = 'cicd_scopes'
  LEFT JOIN cicd_deployment_commits cdc2 ON cdc.cicd_deployment_id = cdc2.cicd_deployment_id
  LEFT JOIN project_pr_metrics ppm ON ppm.deployment_commit_id = cdc2.id
  WHERE pm.project_name IN (${project})
    AND cdc.result = 'SUCCESS'
    AND cdc.environment = 'PRODUCTION'
    AND $__timeFilter(cdc.finished_date)
  GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(cdc.finished_date, '%Y-%m')
),
cfr_metrics AS (
  SELECT
    DATE_FORMAT(deployment_finished_date, '%Y-%m') AS month,
    SUM(has_incident) / NULLIF(COUNT(deployment_id), 0) AS cfr
  FROM (
    SELECT
      d.deployment_id,
      d.deployment_finished_date,
      COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN i.id IS NOT NULL THEN d.deployment_id ELSE NULL END) AS has_incident
    FROM (
      SELECT
        cdc.cicd_deployment_id AS deployment_id,
        MAX(cdc.finished_date) AS deployment_finished_date
      FROM cicd_deployment_commits cdc
      JOIN project_mapping pm ON cdc.cicd_scope_id = pm.row_id AND pm.`table` = 'cicd_scopes'
      WHERE pm.project_name IN (${project})
        AND cdc.result = 'SUCCESS'
        AND cdc.environment = 'PRODUCTION'
      GROUP BY 1
      HAVING $__timeFilter(MAX(cdc.finished_date))
    ) d
    LEFT JOIN project_incident_deployment_relationships pim ON d.deployment_id = pim.deployment_id
    LEFT JOIN incidents i ON pim.id = i.id
    GROUP BY 1, 2
  ) failure_data
  GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(deployment_finished_date, '%Y-%m')
)
SELECT 
  COALESCE(ai.month, dm.month, cfr.month) AS 'Month',
  COALESCE(ai.active_users, 0) AS 'Kiro Users',
  COALESCE(ai.credits, 0) AS 'Credits Used',
  ai.credits_per_message AS 'Credits per Message',
  COALESCE(ai.messages, 0) AS 'Messages',
  COALESCE(ai.conversations, 0) AS 'Conversations',
  COALESCE(dm.deployments, 0) AS 'Deployments',
  ROUND(dm.avg_lead_time, 1) AS 'Lead Time (hours)',
  cfr.cfr AS 'Change Failure Rate'
FROM ai_metrics ai
LEFT JOIN dora_metrics dm ON ai.month = dm.month
LEFT JOIN cfr_metrics cfr ON ai.month = cfr.month
ORDER BY ai.month DESC

panels.title: Monthly Kiro + DORA Metrics
